أحتفي (form VIII)
# أَحْتَفِي (ʔaḥtafī) /ʔaħ.ta.fiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# أَحْتَفِيَ (ʔaḥtafiya) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
